legend.0: A single value in a single activity must change, such as one selector attribute, one timeout, one constant or one configuration key.
legend.1: A logic change confined to one workflow file, such as adding a null or empty check, fixing one expression, or wrapping one activity in a retry scope.
legend.2: Coordinated changes across several workflow files, or changes to the arguments or data passed between workflows.
legend.3: A redesign of error handling or of the framework, a package dependency upgrade, or a root cause that is unclear and needs deep investigation before any change.
